title: Trypanosoma Protocol
author: Ngomtcho, Sen Claudcne Henlcette
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Obtain DNA template
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from each collected Trypanosoma sample to be tested.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Set up a PCR reaction using the ITS1 primers ITS1‑InF and ITS1‑InR (sequences listed in Table 1) and the extracted DNA as template.

steps.title: Amplify ITS1 region
steps.instruction: Run the PCR under the cycling conditions calculated from the available database sequences (annealing temperature and cycle numbers as described in the literature).

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the PCR products onto an agarose gel alongside a Malkel GeneRulel 50 bp ladder (Lane M). Load the following samples in the indicated lanes:

substeps.instruction: Lane 10: T. congolense folemt and T. congolense kilifi (species plasmids)
Lane C: negative control (no DNA template)

steps.title: Interpret band sizes
steps.instruction: Compare observed fragment sizes to expected ranges: 550–700 bp → T. congolense kilifi; 400–450 bp → T. congolense forest/savannah; 198–250 bp → T. vivax; unexpected bands of ~320 bp and ~100 bp may also appear.

steps.title: Confirm by sequencing
steps.instruction: Subclone representative PCR products and sequence them to obtain final confirmation of species identity.
